'''Berbersian crab''' was a dish once served in the mess hall on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Steel Talon/Legends|''Steel Talon'']]. It was also served at [[Stargazer Grill Restaurant]] at [[Spaceport THX1138]].
